2607.21255.title: slang.gr as a Large-Scale Crowdsourced Resource for Non-Standard Greek
2607.21255.paper_summary: Slang is a central component of everyday language, reflecting linguistic creativity, social identity, and cultural change, yet its dy- namic and non-standard nature makes it difficult to model computationally. We present the first large-scale computational study of slang.gr, a crowdsourced lexicon of Greek non-standard language, combining lexical content, user-generated tags, and interaction data. To enable the systematic analysis, we map noisy folksonomic tags to a structured multi-layer taxonomy capturing both semantic categories and sociolinguistic metadata. Using this representation, we analyze the linguistic structure of Greek slang and the behavior of its contributor community. We find that slang is strongly centered on person-related and evaluative language, exhibits high morphological creativity, and is shaped by highly skewed participation with short user lifespans and overlapping communities. Building on these signals, we introduce a community-based confidence score for definitions that integrates user roles, interaction patterns, and moderation signals. Our results show that taxonomy-based representations improve interpretability while retaining meaningful aspects of behavioral structure, enabling a more structured and interpretable analysis of confidence signals. Overall, this work establishes slang.gr as a computational resource for non-standard Greek and provides a foundation for sociolinguistic NLP, bias analysis, and the study of informal language in LLMs.
2607.21255.paper_summary_zh: 俚語是日常語言的核心組成部分，反映了語言創造力、社會身份和文化變遷，然而其動態和非標準的特性使得計算建模變得困難。我們提出了第一個大規模的俚語計算研究，這是一個眾包的希臘非標準語言詞典，結合了詞彙內容、用戶生成的標籤和互動數據。為了實現系統分析，我們將嘈雜的民間標籤映射到一個結構化的多層分類法中，以捕捉語義類別和社會語言學元數據。利用這種表示方法，我們分析了希臘俚語的語言結構及其貢獻者社區的行為。我們發現，俚語強烈集中於與人相關的評價性語言，展現出高度的形態創造力，並受到參與度高度偏斜的影響，參與者壽命短暫且社區重疊。在這些信號的基礎上，我們引入了一個基於社區的定義信心分數，整合了用戶角色、互動模式和管理信號。我們的結果顯示，基於分類法的表示提高了可解釋性，同時保留了行為結構的有意義方面，使信心信號的分析更加結構化和可解釋。總體而言，這項工作將 slang.gr 建立為一個非標準希臘語的計算資源，並為社會語言學自然語言處理、偏見分析以及大型語言模型中的非正式語言研究提供了基礎。
